This moss is found chiefly in cold climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known in northern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

Edram must be swallowed soon after preparation, ideally within a minute. Once the bone fragments have been correctly aligned and immobilised, this moss can cause them to knit together in about two hours. Such rapid treatment is invaluable far from trained healers, although repeated doses carry a risk of habituation.
